individual-data-points.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic explaining image cropping/rotation/resizing plus example micrographs; there is no plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Panel b shows a schematic and example micrographs illustrating image spacing; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel c shows a schematic and example micrographs illustrating insets/zoom; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel d shows a min/max brightness-contrast schematic and example grayscale micrographs; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel e shows a schematic (colored 'Aa' circles) and example micrographs illustrating channel annotation; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel f shows a schematic (venn-like overlap) and example micrographs illustrating grayscale channels; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel g shows calibration-scale schematics and example micrographs with intensity legends; there is no averaged-data plot requiring individual data points.
